_comment: Marketer agent — the dev team's external voice. Owns the full campaign lifecycle (brief → discovery → plan → execute → measure → analyze). Drafts content for humans to publish; NEVER publishes externally. See agents/marketer/SPEC.md and CLAUDE.md.

modelOverrides._comment: Per-skill model routing. `conversational` is the lightweight default (brand/positioning/campaign/metrics Q&A + lookups + routing) — it produces no external content and doesn't load brand-voice/editorial-calendar/shared-surface/session-state, so it runs on Haiku at ~1/3 the token rates; a bare question stays cheap instead of loading heavy context on Sonnet. Content/analysis skills (campaign-lead/content-writer/social-community/email-lifecycle/creative-brief/benchmarking/growth-analyst/pr-brand-steward) stay on the default Sonnet-5 — synthesis + brand voice need the depth (Opus opt-in stays for high-stakes PR, per the notes below).

costCap._comment: Marketer is the heaviest agent — multi-week campaigns + weekly benchmarking + content production. See agents/PROTOCOLS.md → Token / Cost Resilience Protocol.

allow: _note: allow is not a restriction today. The SDK treats allowedTools as auto-allowed without prompting and says to use the tools option to restrict, which the router does not set yet. So this list documents what the agent actually uses, and it becomes the real boundary the moment tools is wired from it. Write/Edit/TodoWrite are declared here because they were relied on but undeclared, or parked in ask, a tier nothing reads.
permissions._ask_comment: `ask` is READ BY NOTHING. sdkCall passes permissions.allow (allowedTools) and permissions.deny (disallowedTools); no code in router/src reads this field. A tool parked here was not gated behind a prompt — it was simply available, undocumented. Deliberately empty: every entry was resolved to allow, to deny, or deleted as unreachable. Do not re-add — put the tool in allow or deny, or leave it out. Resolved. The three mcp__linear__* entries were deleted: mcp.json carries `_linear`, which activeServers() and collectInProcessMcp() both skip, so Marketer has NO Linear tools. mcp__github__create_pull_request moved to `allow` rather than deny, because it is currently Marketer's ONLY route to its documented output: the SessionEnd `create_pr: true` path returns a "PR queued" side-effect that nothing consumes (git_commit_if_changed.ts defers it to "Phase 6d", which never wired it), so no PR is opened by the hook. Scoped push grants added alongside, mirroring Guardian's, since a PR needs a pushed head ref.

writeScope._comment: Marketer writes: content repo, brand/marketing docs, own state, shared surface with Strategist. Never modifies app code, infra, founding docs, or other agents' territories.

SessionStart._comment: Always load: founding docs (BRAND.md is critical — Marketer's primary house-style reference). NOT small, measured: the four founding docs are 99KB / ~25K tokens (PRODUCT.md alone is 46KB), cache-written on every session including the Haiku conversational ones. That predates the vault index below and is a separate scoping question — trimming what a light session needs from PRODUCT.md is its own change. Recorded here so the next reader does not trust the word "small". Plus the fleet-memory index — shared/README.md and shared/process/README.md, ~4KB / ~1K tokens of table-of-contents with wikilinks, NOT the notes themselves (harness-behavior.md alone is 9KB). Always-on because a vault nobody is told about is not memory: `shared/**` has been on this agent's git_commit paths since the tier was added and no config mentioned it, so the write path was open and the read path did not exist. Follow a wikilink and Read the one note you need — the state repo is already in the session's additionalDirectories. PROTOCOLS.md §8 (Fleet Memory Protocol) says when to read and where a lesson belongs.

Heavy context — SYSTEM.md + ADR index + brand voice + editorial calendar + the shared surface with Strategist — loaded ONLY for the content/analysis skills that use it. The lightweight `conversational` default (brand/campaign/metrics Q&A + lookups) skips this so a one-line answer doesn't cache-write tens-of-K tokens every session; it reads a specific file (brand-voice, a shared-surface doc) on demand instead. See load-hook `only_skills`.
If founding BRAND.md is missing, refuse substantive content work.
SessionStart.message: Cannot produce external content without BRAND.md. Recommend `@strategist-agent kick off Phase 0` first.

SessionStart._comment: Conditional skill-state load. Different campaigns / skills need different state files.

PreToolUse._comment: ★ THE GATE — block any publish-class action on external platforms. This is Marketer's defining constraint. No exceptions.
PreToolUse.message: 🛑 Marketer NEVER publishes/sends/posts externally. Drafts only. Humans publish at the platform level. This rule supersedes urgency — including competitor response.

PreToolUse._comment: Block writes outside Marketer's scope. Marketer doesn't touch app code, infra, founding docs, or other agents' state.
PreToolUse.message: Marketer's write scope is content + brand docs + marketing analytics docs + own state + the shared surface with Strategist. Other paths route to the agent that owns them.

PreToolUse._comment: ★ Customer-testimonial permission gate. Any content using a quote must verify the quote exists in approved.md with approved: yes. Quote text must be matchable in the testimonial library.
PreToolUse.on_violation_message: Customer quote not found in testimonials/approved.md with approved: yes status. Pull the quote OR escalate to a human to collect permission. Never publish content with unapproved testimonials.

PreToolUse._comment: Block git push to default branches.
Block merge — Marketer reviews content PRs but doesn't merge them.
Block scraping login-gated competitor content. Benchmarking is public-info only.
PreToolUse.message: 🛑 Benchmarking is public-information only. No login-gated competitor content.

PostToolUse._comment: After Edit/Write to a markdown content file, run prettier+markdownlint on the changed file.

SessionEnd._comment: Durability for a session that gets cut off. Work lives in the leased worktree, which outlives the session — but the idle pruner reclaims it. This commits whatever is still uncommitted and pushes it, so a cut-off session leaves a real commit on the agent branch instead of a checkout that gets collected. Skips cleanly when the session leased no worktree.
SessionEnd.message_template: [WIP] session ${SESSION_ID} — ${SKILL} (session ended before this was committed)

SessionEnd._comment: Commit Marketer's state changes (brand voice, campaign state, testimonial pipeline, competitors, baselines, etc.).
If content was drafted in the content repo, open a PR. Drafts in the CMS/email/social platforms stay in those platforms (committed via their APIs, not git).

_implementationNotes.model: Sonnet — content quality + synthesis benefit from reasoning. Opus opt-in for high-stakes PR (funding announcements, partnership launches, crisis comms) and foundational BRAND.md exercises. Haiku for short-form social, mechanical changelog updates, weekly benchmarking quick scans.
_implementationNotes.thinking_budget: 6000 tokens — higher than Guardian (4k). Content production + campaign synthesis are heavier-reasoning tasks.
_implementationNotes.max_turns: 40 — campaign mode is multi-week and multi-phase; per-session turns can run long.
_implementationNotes.publish_gate: The deny list + the PreToolUse 'publish action' block are the architectural guarantee. ★ The block matches on action verbs (publish/post_now/send_now/schedule_*/launch/spend) rather than tool names, so a new CMS MCP doesn't accidentally bypass the gate as long as its API verbs are conventional. New CMS/email/social MCP integrations MUST be reviewed for action-verb compliance before connecting.
_implementationNotes.testimonial_gate: Custom validator. Marketer content using customer quotes is checked against testimonials/approved.md before save. The pattern match is approximate; a human reviewer is the final check via the PR.
_implementationNotes.shared_surface_co_ownership: dev-team-state/projects/*/_shared/strategist-marketer/** is co-owned with Strategist (read+write both). Other agents have NO write access to this surface — see Strategist + Guardian settings.json deniedPaths.
mcp_servers_required: cms (project-specific: Webflow / Ghost / WordPress / Contentful / etc.)
_implementationNotes.mcp_action_verbs_must_be_draft_only: When connecting any new CMS / email / social MCP, audit the available actions. If the MCP exposes 'publish' / 'send' / 'post_now' verbs that don't go through the deny list, ADD them to the deny list before connecting. Default-deny on publish-class verbs.
